### The problem, not the solution

What are you trying to do with your board that you cannot do today?

### Your idea

How it would behave, in plain words. Keyboard-friendly if possible.

### Reality check

This project is intentionally tiny. Please confirm you have read the
non-goals — these will not be built here, and that is not a judgement of your
idea:

- [ ] No accounts, authentication, sharing or multi-user features
- [ ] No server, database, cloud storage or real-time sync
- [ ] No frameworks, bundlers, build steps or npm dependencies
- [ ] No comments, attachments, time tracking or reports

If your idea needs any of those, the MIT license means a fork is free and
encouraged — say so in the issue and I will happily link it.

### Would you build it?

- [ ] I would send a pull request for this
